xna-type.name: AchievementCollection
xna-type.summary: Collection holding the achievements belonging to a signed-in gamer.
xna-type.syntax: public sealed class AchievementCollection : IList<Achievement>, ICollection<Achievement>, IEnumerable<Achievement>, IEnumerable, IDisposable
xna-type.remarks: This collection may be indexed by key string or integer order. When you are indexing achievements by integer order or iterating over the collection, achievements are ordered with earned achievements first. They are sorted by most-recently earned, then sorted by unearned non-hidden achievements in the order they were defined using XLAST, and finally sorted by any unearned hidden achievements in XLAST order.
